title: Where next for structural bioinformatics?
content:
by Joe G. Greener

Structural bioinformatics aims to answer biological questions by considering biomolecular structures at scale. We now have accurate predictions and need to ask what we can learn from them. Structural bioinformatics aims to answer biological questions by considering biomolecular structures at scale. This Perspective argues that now that we have accurate predictions, we need to ask what we can learn from them.
